test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which city, on the ghats of the Shipra river, is the Kumbh Mela organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ujjain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sacred city of Ujjain** is located on the **east bank of the Shipra River**.
 
• On the city's ornate riverbank ghats, the **Sinhastha fair (Kumbh Mela)** takes place every 12 years, as do yearly celebrations of the river goddess Kshipra. Along the **Shipra River's banks,** there are hundreds of Hindu shrines.
 
• **The Kumbh Mela** is a water festival. Every 12 years, millions of people flock to the banks of a river in four ancient cities: **Ujjain (Shipra), Nashik (Godavari), Allahabad, and Haridwar (Ganga)** for a dip in the water that promises redemption.
 
• The Shipra, sometimes known as the Kshipra, is a river in central India's Madhya Pradesh state. 
 
• The river begins in the Dhar district and runs north across the Malwa Plateau, eventually joining the Chambal River near the MP-Rajasthan border in Mandsaur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ujjain** is an ancient city in Madhya Pradesh, India, located along the Kshipra River. The centuries-old Mahakaleshwar Temple, a towering edifice with a strikingly decorated roof, is an important Hindu pilgrimage destination.
 
• **Prayagraj was previously known as Allahabad.** The Prayag Kumbh Mela and the Indira Marathon are two cultural and sporting events that have taken place in Allahabad.
 
• **Haridwa**r is an important Hindu pilgrimage place in Uttarakhand, India's northernmost state, where the Ganges River emerges from the Himalayan foothills.
 
• **Nashik** is a historic holy city in Maharashtra, a western Indian state.
